name: BSc in International Relations and Chinese

papers.label: LSE100
lines: LSE100 is a half unit taken by all students, running across Autumn and Winter Terms in the first year. The course provides one of the marks that is eligible to be included in the calculation of the First Year Average for purposes of classification.
Students will choose ONE of the three half-unit options below:
LSE100A The LSE Course: How can we transform our climate futures? (0.5)
LSE100B The LSE Course: How can we control AI? (0.5)
LSE100C The LSE Course: How can we create a fair society? (0.5)

papers.label: Skills Course
lines: Students take the following non-assessed course:
IR102 Thinking Globally: Studying International Relations (0.0)

lines: IR100 International Relations: Theories, Concepts and Debates (1.0)

HY113 Empires and Resistance in Global History (1.0)

lines: One from the following:
LN104 Mandarin Language and Society Level 1 (Beginner) (1.0)
LN140 Mandarin Language and Society 3 (Advanced) (1.0)
LN142 Mandarin Language and Society 2 (Intermediate) (1.0)

papers.label: Paper 4

papers.label: Note
lines: Students who select LN104 under paper 3 will complete an 8 week intensive tailor made language programme at Fudan University, China, between Years 1 and 2.
